action_summary: The repair capability's learning chain was switched off by default and no production caller ever switched it on, so the measured 6 -> 0 collapse in search invocations never reached the solver. A new derivation module builds the scope the session needs from facts the tree already states -- the test corpus the repair is verified against, hashed, plus the single non-test module when the tree has exactly one -- and enables retained learning with operator generalization only where that derivation succeeds. It declines with a named reason otherwise, never guesses, and a caller that states a configuration keeps it verbatim including {'enabled': False}. Ten tests, six of which fail on the base commit; a first repair on an unseen project searches and teaches, and the second is answered from memory with zero search invocations and the suite green both times. A second, smaller defect lands with it and is carried verbatim under `supersedes`: the environment-transfer status returned PASS__ENVIRONMENT_SOLVED_BY_RECALLED_PLAN from both the replay path and a warm-started search, so a run that saved nothing was reported as instant learning; it now returns a distinct status and every path carries both keys. A third landing rides with this pull request and is recorded here rather than as a second intent: operator_generalization_v1 matched an operator's characters without checking it had found a whole token, so an arrow's '>' was rewritten into '->=' and '>>' could become '>>='; a maximal-token guard now refuses fragments, and language_neutral_skill_bridge_v1 offers the operator-swap form of a lesson as well as its stored skeleton, which takes cross-language carry from 4/5 to 5/5 (Rust was previously unreachable because it writes the fix as a tail expression). Proposals widened; acceptance did not: every candidate still passes parses_in and the caller's mandatory verifier, and a test holds the refusal side. A fourth landing rides here: a reproducible routing-reach census, which finds 141 capabilities and 259 declared effects, 48 self-reached by their own declared vocabulary, 55 routed elsewhere, and 38 unreached of which 35 raise GOAL_INPUT_BINDING_REQUIRED because their templates demand role-shaped inputs no prose sentence states. The census carries an explicit non-claim -- templated addresses are not a reach denominator -- because its own validity check showed a capability recorded UNREACHED can be reached by one ordinary English sentence, and a test pins that. No routing behaviour was changed.

supersedes.reason: Both changes were committed on one branch and will land as one pull request, and the drift guard admits exactly one action intent per pull request. Rather than drop a record, the earlier intent is carried here verbatim under this key and its separate file is removed. Nothing it asserted is withdrawn: it remains the authority for the transfer-status correction, and this intent is the authority for the retained-learning default. The two are one action unit because both are configuration/reporting defects that hid a measured gain the mechanism had already earned.

tournament.decisive_question: Does the second repair of the same breakage in an unseen project spend zero search invocations while the first spends at least one, with the suite green after both?
tournament.no_known_counterexample_reason: The nearest world in which the default must not fire is a project where the stored lesson is the wrong answer; test_a_different_correct_answer_is_still_repaired_correctly builds it and requires a correct repair, not a recalled one. test_an_explicit_off_is_honoured_and_never_overridden pins that a stated decision is never overridden, and test_two_source_files_decline_with_a_named_reason pins that ambiguity declines rather than guesses. The matcher's nearest wrong world is pinned from both sides: test_an_arrow_is_not_a_comparison and test_a_shift_is_not_a_comparison require the fragments to be refused, while test_the_comparison_it_should_find_is_still_found_next_to_an_arrow requires the real occurrence beside an arrow to still be found -- so the guard cannot silence the lesson it protects.

why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: The session already required exactly two facts to run -- a scope key and a target -- and the tree already contains both: which tests judge the repair, and which module is under repair when there is only one. No new mechanism, no external source, no dependency, zero spend; the whole change is a derivation of inputs the capability was already waiting for.
